title: Label a task shelf
prompt: Two supplied text values, area and owner, identify a shelf. Give the fixed label the name label using const. It must contain the area, a slash with one space on each side, and the owner, in that order. For area "Desk" and owner "Jo", produce "Desk / Jo". Keep empty text and all input spaces exactly as supplied.
hints: Write down the three pieces of text in their final order.
The slash and its two spaces are themselves a text value.
Use + between text values. Quoting a variable name would put that name in the label.

rules.name: label
rules.message: Use const for the fixed label.

feedback: Compare the order and spaces against the two inputs in the failed case.
